**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear sizing hints when a component ID is reused**

When a chart placed with content is removed via `remove_chart()`, its entry remains in `_sizing_hints`. If another chart is then added with the same explicit component ID but without content, this conditional leaves the old hint attached to the new chart. Sending the layout consequently checks the replacement against the removed chart's content, producing spurious warnings or preventing a valid dashboard save in strict mode. Remove the hint when deleting a component, or clear any previous hint when adding a component without content.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L125-L128](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/5f61f08f6df44fd88f57cd180ebcc56efd2a4750/AGENTS.md#L125-L128)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Check markdown against its current text before sending**

If a caller edits a markdown component through the returned handle's `meta["code"]`, the sizing check still estimates the original text captured in `_SizingHint`. For example, replacing a short automatically sized block with many paragraphs passes strict mode at the original small height even though the current text is clipped; shortening a block can conversely reject a correctly adjusted height. For markdown components, derive the estimate from the current `meta["code"]` when checking the layout rather than the placement-time snapshot.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L125-L126](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/5f61f08f6df44fd88f57cd180ebcc56efd2a4750/AGENTS.md#L125-L126)

causal_evidence: O commit 5f61f08f6df44fd88f57cd180ebcc56efd2a4750, filho direto da base 75e3d843204eff54004914d74c7e89c7ff444853, introduziu a validação de dimensionamento com o texto capturado na inserção.
O commit seguinte, c4f15c6f2c69f3e2684592c92319056d64ba9958, é o HEAD fornecido e altera a validação para usar o texto atual.
evidences: Em 5f61f08, supersetapiplus/dashboards/layout/__init__.py:241 passa o hint original a self._estimate sem consultar meta["code"].
No HEAD c4f15c6, supersetapiplus/dashboards/layout/__init__.py:241 lê meta["code"] e a linha 243 substitui o conteúdo do hint de Markdown pelo texto atual antes da estimativa.
tests/unit/test_layout_sizing_builder.py:201 cobre a edição de um Markdown curto para 20 parágrafos e exige SizingError no envio em modo strict.
payload.headline: O dimensionamento de Markdown já usa o texto atual no HEAD
payload.before: A validação estimava o Markdown pelo texto capturado na inserção, mesmo depois de uma edição via meta["code"].
payload.after: A validação lê o texto atual de meta["code"] e o usa na estimativa.
payload.motivation: Sem a correção, o modo strict podia aceitar uma altura insuficiente após o texto crescer ou rejeitar uma altura adequada após o texto encolher.
payload.reply: The finding was valid in 5f61f08 and is already addressed by c4f15c6. The sizing check now estimates Markdown from the current `meta["code"]`, and a regression test covers editing a short auto-sized block into a longer one in strict mode. No further code change is needed.
